verdict.rationale: Veo is a video-generation model and API service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server. The Interactions API and references to the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform are adjacent API surfaces, not an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
